scope: Curve25519-family miniature k = 28 and 32, wwalk g=1 grow=2 incumbents of round 33, ecbench counted GAE, local route L1, 16 walk seeds x 32 fresh targets; no signed replay or recompute
statement: R4-I1 (research/curve25519_autolab_20261104/r4-i1, ideas/STRUCTURE-R4.md): the wwalk table is one fixed draw per curve and configuration (round 33 k = 32 holdout: GAE minus probes 22,392..22,701 across all 96 runs of the selected arm), so the ic_autolab holdouts resampled only the probe phase. Re-running the round 33 incumbents under walk seeds 0..15 (32 fresh targets each; audit 1088/1088 records, 8 replays reproduced) gives seed-averaged S 1.781 [1.602, 1.960] at k = 32 (SD 0.335; rho-neg 0.977; distance 1.82x) and 1.969 [1.808, 2.131] at k = 28 (SD 0.304; rho-neg 1.059; distance 1.86x). Seed 0, the incumbent's own table, is 1.480 and 1.707. The round 31 and 33 distances to rho (1.49x to 1.55x at k = 28, 32) reflect a favourable table draw; the expected distance is about 1.8x to 1.9x.
